summary: Sony Group Corporation filed a Form 6-K on May 8, 2026, reporting consolidated financial results for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026, which include the disclosure of a partial spin-off of Sony Financial Group Inc. (SFGI), a formerly wholly-owned subsidiary, executed on October 1, 2025. The SFGI spin-off was approved by Sony's Board of Directors on May 14, 2025. As a result, the Financial Services business is classified as a discontinued operation separate from continuing operations. The spin-off is a structural separation creating a distinct publicly-traded entity. No price, premium, advisor, or timeline specifics beyond the October 1, 2025 effective date are provided. Watch for the spin-off's impact on Sony's post-separation earnings and the market reception of the new standalone SFGI shares.
